scope: Supplementary actual call-chain source review; static facts are not runtime performance proof. No source was edited.
reviewed_chain: StatsHandle writer starts Runtime::start; Runtime spawns dedicated source worker and returns without waiting for historical EOF
Worker submits bounded envelope and waits for durable writer ACK; committed offsets and facts are transactionally coupled
Status progress aggregates checkpoint table COUNT/SUM only, never source-body scanning
Runtime publishes discovery-complete/root-found state separately; full scan displayed as indeterminate by UI
Visible status poll queues status read every2s; only explicit check buttons enqueue source scans
UI validates nonnegative counts and committed+remaining=total, caps unfinished progress below100%, displays file/byte units and separate imported count
Paused/error paths retain committed snapshot; unknown discovery does not show determinate percentage
